newsitem.title: GREECE: Gunmen shoot dead Greek shipowner Peratikos.
newsitem.headline: Gunmen shoot dead Greek shipowner Peratikos.

text.p: Three gunmen shot dead Greek shipowner Constantine Peratikos, 42, on Wednesday as he was leaving his office in the port of Pireaus, police said.
They said it was still unclear whether it was a criminal attack or the work of one of Greece's deadly urban guerrilla groups.
Police said the gunmen laid an ambush and then escaped by hijacking a taxi and driving away.
Hospital officials said Peratikos had been shot several times and died before reaching the hospital.
The Peratikos Group, owned by one of Greece's major shipping families, briefly owned the troubled Elefsis Shipyards, which are now back in state hands.
